summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API, which underpins technologies like video conferencing, have introduced several enhancements aimed at improving functionality and performance. Notably, new statistics regarding encoded keyframes in outbound RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) connections have been implemented, allowing developers to gain insights into video quality. Additionally, the API now includes the ability to retrieve remote certificates, enhancing security during peer-to-peer connections. **These changes are significant as they not only refine the way data is handled and reported but also bolster the security and efficiency of real-time communication experiences.** Other adjustments focus on code quality and optimization, ensuring that the underlying architecture of these features is both robust and modernized, while making it easier for developers to maintain the API.
